Issuing authority for FSSAI Food Business Registration / Licence: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FoSCoS)
Documents for FSSAI Food Business Registration / Licence: Photo ID; Passport photo; Proof of premises (rent agreement / ownership); List of food products; Food safety management plan (licence tier)

Fee for FSSAI Food Business Registration / Licence: FSSAI revised its fee slabs and licence validity in 2026; the fee is calculated on FoSCoS for your business type, so confirm the amount there before paying
Apply for FSSAI Food Business Registration / Licence on the official portal: https://foscos.fssai.gov.in/
FSSAI Food Business Registration / Licence: Mandatory for every food business operator in India.
Expected timeline for FSSAI Food Business Registration / Licence: Registration: about 7 days; State licence: about 30-60 days incl. inspection
Issuing authority for GST Registration: GST Council / Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN)
Documents for GST Registration: PAN; Aadhaar; Proof of business premises; Bank account proof; Passport photo
Fee for GST Registration: Free of charge
Apply for GST Registration on the official portal: https://www.gst.gov.in/

GST Registration: Needed above the turnover threshold or for inter-state supply / e-commerce. The CGST Act (s.22) sets Rs 20 lakh (Rs 10 lakh in special category states); suppliers of goods only can have Rs 40 lakh where the state has opted in, and a few states (a CBIC 2019 update listed Telangana) kept Rs 20 lakh. Confirm the current limit for your state on the GST portal.
Expected timeline for GST Registration: Typically 3-7 working days after application
